description: Geographic Access to 13 Types of AD/ADRD-Related Healthcare Facilities in the United States: Spatial Accessibility and Origin-Destination Travel Time Matrix is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Kyusik Kim, Kyusik Kim. This dataset provides three types of geographic access measures at the U.S. census block group level with transportation network-based origin-destination (OD) travel time matrices between 239,780 block groups and healthcare facilities across 13 Alzheimer's Disease and Alzheimer's Disease-Related Dementias-related healthcare service types. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. Formats: ZIP, TXT. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0 1.0. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
